name: declared roles in CAST: order, announcer and narrator included
script:
CAST: ANNOUNCER=m "forties, warm, brisk", NARRATOR=f "sixties, low, even", MAE=f "fifties, dry, unhurried", TOBY=m "twenties, quick"
[MUSIC: a thin organ line]
ANNOUNCER: Good evening.
NARRATOR: The pond froze early that year.
MAE: (dry) Sit down, Toby.
TOBY: I would rather stand.

name: an undeclared speaker comes after the declared roles, in order of first line
script:
CAST: MAE=f "fifties, dry", TOBY=m
NED: Morning.
MAE: Morning, Ned.
CLERK: Next.
NED: Again.
